subject: Air freight quote to EZE
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote your cheapest air freight option to EZE (Buenos Aires, AR)? The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-26 at our site in 71445 (Boeblingen), Germany. Please arrange the truck from our site to the departure airport.

The shipment consists of 1 piece of electronic control units, with a gross weight of 485 kg and a volume of 3.66 cbm.

Please quote an all-in price in EUR, including pickup and trucking to the airport.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH
